title: Do cats rot your teeth? Preregistration, code, outputs, process logs and transcripts of a study produced by an AI agent (NHANES 2005–2006)
summary: This record holds the preregistration, code, outputs, process logs and session transcripts of a study that is also a meta-experiment on research produced almost entirely by an AI agent (Claude, model claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic, run in Claude Code) under the direction of one researcher. The substantive study asks a deliberately implausible question, posed by the author: is living with a cat associated with untreated dental decay among US adults? It uses public data from NHANES 2005–2006 with survey-weighted modified Poisson regression, prespecified confounders, sensitivity analyses and…
